evaluation: zero-shot transfer (trained on synthetic only, no fine-tuning)
notes: Models were trained exclusively on synthetic Bergman-ODE data and evaluated on real patients with no retraining.
Shanghai provides real CGM + EHR but no consumer-wearable streams; absent wearable features were neutralized to training medians, so this validates the CGM + EHR pathway of the fused model.
The persistence baseline is computed on the same real windows and is the fair bar a useful 2-hour forecaster must beat.
